_doc: Targets of the pass line (bench/deps_bench.py, `make bench-passline`). Data only. expect_coarsened (default 0): how many components stats.scc_coarsened must be (ADR-124, -scc-coarsen: from 5500 dependency functions in one component). A target that is not meant to be hit (memos, gitea, cocoon) must have 0, and the pass line fails when it is hit; dart-pub and dart_services have the largest components (7,550 and 13,895) and are hit, so they have 1. repo + commit: fetched into $BENCH_CACHE (default ~/.cache/rivus-bench/), never into this tree; the code of a target is never run (git clone/checkout, `go mod download`, `dart pub get`). args: the flags of `rivus analyze` besides -lang and -C (the default flags; `{root}` is the root of the fetched tree, for -allow-deps-under). time_limit_s / mem_cap_gb: the pass line. pass_line: the name of the row of the pass line (the table of `make docs-gen WHAT=passline` is made from the targets that have it). decided: false = the line is printed as INFO (the limits are not decided yet). detect: per vulnerability. mode location (memos): detected when a finding of the category has its source and its sink at the labelled positions of the truth file (bench/memos), at the pre-fix commit; quiet_after_fix is the count of the category at the fixed commit. mode through: see dart-pub.

memos._doc: Not a row of the pass line since 2026-11-25 (user decision: A, memos-4gib, is the same target with a stricter memory limit, so it contains the memory and the time of this row, and carries the same detect). The target stays for graph-check and --cost-check; run it by name only for reference.

memos-4gib._doc: Pass line A: the same as memos with `-max-memory 4GiB`, the default limit of a machine with 16 GB of physical memory (ADR-121): the same conditions as that machine. Time 180 s, peak of the process tree within 4 GiB, converged, detected (the same places as memos).

gitea._doc: Pass line C: Gitea v1.26.4 (go-gitea/gitea), the whole program with the default flags and the dependencies, `-no-project-rules`. Peak of the process tree within 8 GB, converged; time 600 s (the limit of the earlier runs, 10 minutes; 180 s has no ground for Gitea). Added for its size. detect.mode score: per published vulnerability of bench/gitea-cve-truth.json, judged by place (bench/score.py form: source function, sink file and line, functions on the path); the line prints `detected=<n>/3`, which is NOT part of PASS/FAIL, now or later (decided 2026-11-24: reference only; a regression of a memory change is checked by the sameness of the graph representation). The ledger row and the line carry the count n/3 only: no finding count, list, path or place.

cocoon._doc: flutter/cocoon `app_dart` (the server that manages the CI of Flutter). Launch: -C app_dart, -allow-deps-under the packages of the repository, `dart pub get` only, and the Flutter member of the root workspace removed in the COPY. No public fixed vulnerability of the project is known (no security advisory), so detected is n/a.

dart-pub._doc: dart-lang/pub at the parent of the fix of GHSA-q739-79rh-vmvp / CVE-2026-27704 (zip slip in extractTarGz; bench/dart-pub). detect.mode through: per vulnerability, detected when a finding passes through a labelled position of the truth file (bench/score.py --through); through_tp is the position count, information. INFO until its line is decided; the default-flags run does not converge today, so detected is no.

dart_services._doc: pass line D (user decision, 2026-11-24): converge within 600 s and 8 GB, default flags; detection is n/a (no public vulnerability). The limit of 600 s is for the same reason as Gitea (C): 180 s has no ground. Also a target of the depth experiments

shlex._doc: INFO row of Rust (not a pass line, not in the default TARGETS; run it by name: make bench-passline TARGETS=shlex): rust-shlex 1.3.0 (tag 1.3.0), a public crate with no dependency, no build.rs and no proc macro, MIT OR Apache-2.0. It shows that the Rust road (fetch, the build under the sandbox with the pinned nightly, the extractor, the analysis) goes through from one end to the other in this tool, and it records the convergence and the count of each kind of uncertainty (settings of the row). The time and the memory of the row mean nothing (under 1 s; the memory is a few tens of MB to about 130 MB depending on how it is measured, and the 0.25 s sample of the tree can miss the build): do not read them as a result. decided false (INFO), detect none (n/a). The crate has no Cargo.lock, so the tool writes the smallest one (version 4, one [[package]]) in the COPY only; rust_minimal_lock is for a crate with no dependency and the tool refuses it when Cargo.toml names one (cargo generate-lockfile is never run). A .cargo/config(.toml) or a rust-toolchain(.toml) in the tree stops the run. HOME is an empty directory in $BENCH_CACHE; sandbox-exec must deny a write before the run, and summary.isolation.mode must be sandbox after it, else the run is a failure.

rustypaste._doc: INFO row of Rust (not a pass line, not in the default TARGETS; run it by name: make bench-passline TARGETS=rustypaste): orhun/rustypaste (MIT) at 0029207, the parent of the fix of CVE-2026-90774 (path traversal; fix ac05d55, PR #623). A real application with dependencies (actix); its Cargo.lock is the committed one, used as it is (the tool never runs cargo generate-lockfile and never runs cargo itself: the dependencies are fetched by the fetch stage of rivus under the sandbox). The row records whether the analysis converges, and scc_coarsened / largest_scc_deps (the dependency actix made a component of 7,492 functions before ADR-124), with -timeout 600s of rivus; the watchdog of the tool (time_limit_s, over the build too) and the 8 GB tree-RSS cap stop a run that goes beyond. SDKROOT of the machine: BENCH_RUST_SDKROOT (bench/README.md). decided false (INFO). detect: detected by place (mode location, truth bench/rustypaste/truth-00292076.json), the fixed commit is read only to record quiet_after_fix (not judged until `guards:` exists; bench/rustypaste/README.md).

smoke._doc: a small local tree (bench/go-curated), to check that the script works end to end; not a target

dart-archive._doc: brendan-duncan/archive (package:archive) at 3.3.7, the last affected version of CVE-2023-39139 / GHSA-9v85-q87q-g4vg (extractArchiveToDisk creates a symlink whose target is the stored name, with no check); 3.3.8 is the fixed version. Dart DETECTION target: detected per vulnerability (detect.mode through, truth bench/dart-archive/truth-6fc3b89f.json), builtin models (the entry-name sources of package:archive), default flags, `dart pub get` only; the code is never run. INFO until its line is decided. Quiet-after-fix is recorded (bench/dart-archive/README.md), not part of the line.
